### CVE-2025-0061 — Multiple vulnerabilities in SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2025-01-14 | Updated: 2025-01-14 | Max CVSS: 8.7
- CWE: CWE-497 CWE-497: Exposure of Sensitive System Information to an Unauthorized Control Sphere
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.7 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform allows an unauthenticated attacker to perform session hijacking over the network without any user interaction, due to an information disclosure vulnerability. Attacker can access and modify all the data of the application.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Platform: affected ENTERPRISE 420; affected 430; affected 2025

- https://me.sap.com/notes/3474398

### CVE-2025-0063 — SQL Injection vulnerability in SAP NetWeaver AS for ABAP and ABAP Platform
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2025-01-14 | Updated: 2025-01-14 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-89 CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP and ABAP Platform does not check for authorization when a user executes some RFC function modules. This could lead to an attacker with basic user privileges to gain control over the data in Informix database, leading to complete compromise of confidentiality, integrity and availability.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP and ABAP Platform: affected SAP_BASIS 700; affected SAP_BASIS 701; affected SAP_BASIS 702; affected SAP_BASIS 731; affected SAP_BASIS 740; affected SAP_BASIS 750; affected SAP_BASIS 751; affected SAP_BASIS 752; affected SAP_BASIS 753; affected SAP_BASIS 754; affected SAP_BASIS 755; affected SAP_BASIS 756; affected SAP_BASIS 757; affected SAP_BASIS 758

### CVE-2025-30012 — Multiple vulnerabilities in SAP Supplier Relationship Management (Live Auction Cockpit)
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2025-05-13 | Updated: 2025-07-24 | Max CVSS: 10
- CWE: CWE-502 CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 10 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

The Live Auction Cockpit in SAP Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) uses a deprecated java applet component, which allows an unauthenticated attacker to send malicious payload request in a specific encoding format. The servlet will then decode this malicious request which will result in deserialization of data in the application leading to execution of arbitrary OS command on target as SAP Administrator. This vulnerability has High impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the application.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP Supplier Relationship Management (Live Auction Cockpit): affected SRM_SERVER 7.14

References:
- https://me.sap.com/notes/3578900

A similarly crafted submission can be used to perform an out-of-bounds read operation as well, revealing sensitive information that is loaded in memory at that time. There is no ability to modify any information.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP (BIC Document): affected S4COREOP 104; affected 105; affected 106; affected 107; affected 108; affected SEM-BW 600; affected 602; affected 603; affected 604; affected 605; affected 634; affected 736; affected 746; affected 747; affected 748
